status: Source-backed candidates, not benchmark winners. Tags observed in official GitHub releases/latest responses; check independent package channels before adoption.

watch.notes: Adaptive chunking, resume, ghd CLI, aria2-compatible RPC; GPLv3 source. Verify desktop/service prerequisites and portability.
Firecrawl Local Rust CLI, local document extraction and localhost v2 API. Repository/server, local crate, SDK and hosted service have different version channels. Review component licenses.
Self-hosted extraction/crawling; compare completeness, resources and local operation.
JS/TS crawling; queues, persistence, HTTP and browser routing.
Isolated browser automation; validate compatible browser binaries.
Multi-protocol CLI/RPC baseline. Older release does not establish abandonment.
Authorized storage transfers; compare streaming, checksums and sync semantics.
Change monitoring, semantic diff and refresh.
Dependency discovery and reviewed upgrade grouping.

Optional final escalation for extraction requiring actual interactions. Turn repeatable routes into deterministic adapters once understood. Limits: Current browser and model defaults are cloud-backed; Version pinning is needed because the 1.x interface differs materially from older examples; Agent planning is not the default low-latency path for metadata, RSS or simple HTTP catalogs; No feedback or telemetry message was sent during this review

Use Athena's validated fetch path once, preserve original bytes and metadata, then dispatch conversion by content type. Supply seekable spooled streams for large inputs. Limits: convert_response collects the body in BytesIO; convert_stream buffers an entire nonseekable stream; Markdown is not a high-fidelity source-artifact replacement; Image captioning and speech transcription can depend on hosted services; It is not crawl orchestration

Candidate parsing/adapter layer for changing markup, with fixture replay and validation of recovered fields. Reuse already fetched responses. Limits: A similarity match is not proof of field identity or correctness; Preserve required fields, pagination and type checks before accepting selector recovery; Upstream universal access/bypass marketing was not verified and is not an acceptance claim

Keep separate for an explicitly requested Android-only extraction workflow. Do not add it to ordinary web acquisition dependencies. Limits: Not a web crawler, HTML parser or structured extraction engine; Requires an Android device and applicable device permissions

Use as adapter-authoring assistance with pre-fetched HTML and multiple recorded page variants. Keep the host's network/cancellation/error policies. Limits: Source _fetch_html uses direct requests.get with no default timeout/status check; request_args.pop('headers') mutates the caller's dictionary; Learned rules rely on class/style attributes and structural/positional traversal; No-maintenance claims are not justified

Keep transport compatibility optional behind the host acquisition contract. Compare maintained descendants such as lexiforest/curl_cffi before selecting a package. Limits: Inspected original profile table includes Chrome 116/Firefox 117 and older profiles; Does not execute application JavaScript; Handshake emulation is not every browser behavior and does not guarantee access
Maintained curl-impersonate descendant candidate with Python bindings and current browser profiles; compare exact browser behavior and complete outputs before adoption. Not JavaScript execution.
